items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I had the whole thing out there. The arrangement was good, too, man, kind of like Stravinsky -- I mean, like Boyd Raeburn and Duke at the same time.

ctx.x: (Singing.) I had the whole thing out there. The arrangement was good, too, man, kind of like Stravinsky -- I mean, like Boyd Raeburn and Duke at the same time.
Well, I remember when I heard Mingus Fingers for the first time, about -- I think it was Decca or something.
